summary: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting the automatic conversion of its Series B Convertible Preferred Stock into common stock pursuant to pre-set terms, with 408,434.7 preferred shares converting into 20,421,735 common shares. The preferred stock was originally sold at $65.00 per share in a prior private placement; no new cash consideration, premium, or board recommendation was involved. The conversion was exempt under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act and did not constitute a sale. Also included was shareholder approval of equity incentive plan increases. This is a routine capital-structure event, not a special situation.
